limits: Approval covers the exact32selected native2D drawings, complete Canvas source contact, four native weapon-point ROIs, explicit opaque-pixel ownership and proposed fixed densities. Original PNG byte pins were independently checked. Full original source pages were inspected by the artist, not all re-opened by Root.
Reference-led interpretation of original KONAMI PS2 costume plate. Exact retail UVs, hidden surfaces, original animation cycles, absolute metrics and literal1:1 identity remain unverified.
Two separately drawn gait half-steps per native direction; gait is an authored CQC adaptation. No mirrored bitmap, recolour or downsample is admitted as new source art.
Original game-profile contracts must remain exact. Actual mode, menus, pause, sizing and projectile-origin QA are required before installation.

Root physically inspected native-coordinate projected-head/cuff comparisons. Right-B density376 is accepted as a visual common drawing scale; unmapped second neutral309 is excluded. Head projection near0.942 relative to first neutral supports this choice; cuff projection is not bone length or an automatic anthropometric certificate.
